en:
Speech recognition and AI translation run locally on your phone and work offline once models are ready.
Speech models recognize audio; Qwen NPU or OPUS-MT CPU translates text. Some OPUS-MT routes require a Whisper English bridge.
Model downloads require a network connection; captions are not sent to an external translation service.
zh:
语音识别与 AI 翻译均在手机本地完成，模型准备好后支持断网使用。
语音模型负责识别；Qwen NPU 或 OPUS-MT CPU 负责文字翻译。OPUS-MT 的部分路线需要 Whisper 英语中转。
模型下载需要联网，字幕不发送给外部翻译服务。

en:
Use Microphone for live speech, or Device audio for video and streaming apps. Some apps block audio capture. Floating captions work over other apps. Drag anywhere, tuck at either edge and tap the handle to expand.

Choose speech, caption and interface languages and font sizes independently. Speech recognition and text translation have separate model pages with download, selection and removal. Choices are saved.

Qwen3-0.6B / 1.7B / 4B: selectable multilingual NPU text translation directly from recognized source text, without an English bridge. This bundle requires SM8750 / SM8850, Android 15+ and at least 8 GB RAM. The 4B model requires at least 12 GB RAM. See each model for its size. Loading takes a few seconds before recording.

OPUS-MT: smaller CPU language packs for Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Italian and Portuguese. Non-English speech first uses Whisper to produce English; English captions use its output directly. Small bridge models may mistranslate.

Automatic recognition reuses installed system offline packs, otherwise a compatible local model. You can also select a speech model manually. If a changed translation route is incompatible with your manual speech choice, select a compatible model or Automatic.

Compatible NPU models are labeled and recommended first. Portable CPU models serve other compatible phones. Downloading a spare model does not change the selection. All speech and captions are processed locally; only downloads need networking. Backup channels, resume and SHA-256 verification are supported.

Speech only: environmental sound labels are filtered, but background speech or singing can still be recognized. Drafts are revised; quality and latency vary by language, phone and recording conditions.
zh:
麦克风用于现场讲话，手机声音用于视频和直播；部分应用禁止捕获声音。悬浮字幕可在其他应用上显示。拖动任意位置移动，左右贴边隐藏，点击把手展开；回到主界面或通知栏可停止。

在设置中独立选择说话语言、字幕语言、界面语言和字体大小。语音识别与文本翻译分别管理，两类模型都可自由下载、切换和删除；选择会保存。

Qwen3-0.6B / 1.7B / 4B：NPU 文本翻译，可按体积与内存需求选择，均支持多国语言互译，直接翻译识别原文，无需英语中转。当前 NPU 文件适配 SM8750 / SM8850、Android 15 以上及至少 8 GB 内存。4B 至少需要 12 GB 内存。下载及安装大小见各模型详情。模型加载需要数秒，开始录音前会先准备好。

OPUS-MT：CPU 文本翻译，按目标语言下载较小的语言包，提供中文、德语、法语、西班牙语、俄语、阿拉伯语、印地语、意大利语和葡萄牙语。非英语语音需要 Whisper 先转成英语；英语目标直接使用 Whisper 转译结果。小模型中转可能错译。

识别自动模式优先使用已有系统离线语音包，否则使用兼容的本地模型。也可手动选择识别模型。切换翻译路线后，手动选择的识别模型如果不兼容，需要另选兼容模型或自动模式。

适配本机的 NPU 模型在下载列表中优先推荐并标注；CPU 模型供其他兼容手机使用。下载备用模型不会自动切换当前选择。所有声音和字幕均在手机本地处理；模型下载才需要联网，支持备用通道、断点续传及 SHA-256 校验。

仅处理人声，过滤环境音标签；背景里的清晰讲话和歌声仍可能被识别。草稿会持续修正，效果及延迟随语言、手机及录音条件变化。
